authorization.basis: User reviewed the Option D design draft and explicitly authorized implementation.
authorization.scope: synthetic-only plant, babbling, local forward learning, inverse search, and closure gates

research_question: Can a bounded three-gesture controller over a physical vocal-tract area function learn a local motor-to-sensory forward map through label-free babbling and invert unseen synthetic vowel targets while preserving acoustic equivalence, physical validity, and post-hoc vowel identity?

plant.section_lengths: ten equal sections summing to total length
plant.tube_matrix: lossy transmission matrix using gamma=attenuation+j*2*pi*f/c, characteristic impedance rho*c/A, cosh(gamma*l), and sinh(gamma*l)
plant.transfer: lip volume-velocity transfer H=1/(C*Z_lip+D) from the cascaded section matrix
plant.glottal_source: existing 60-harmonic pulse source with 1/h^0.3 tilt at exogenous F0

sensory_representation.transform: evaluate analytic transfer magnitude at centers, add 1e-12, natural log, subtract mean, L2 normalize

loss.envelope: Euclidean distance between unit sensory vectors divided by 2
loss.resonance: mean absolute difference between three deterministic peak-bin indices divided by 23
loss.harmonic: weighted RMS vector difference using 0.5+0.5*exp(-d_to_nearest_harmonic^2/(2*(0.35*F0)^2)), normalized by weight sum

sensory_representation.formants: first three separated local maxima of analytic transfer magnitude on 80-3500 Hz at 5 Hz spacing; minimum separation 150 Hz; ties choose lower frequency

babbling.transition: linearly interpolate each endpoint transition so no coordinate changes by more than 0.25 per 25 ms hop; interpolation states do not update the learner
babbling.f0_assignment: cycle 90,110,140,180 Hz by endpoint ordinal; F0 conditions the source and harmonic confidence but not the tract transfer target

local_forward_model.winner: minimum Euclidean motor distance; lower prototype index breaks ties
local_forward_model.winner_update: accumulate XTX, XTY, and count only for the winning prototype
local_forward_model.fit: solve (XTX+R)B=XTY independently per prototype after the single babbling pass
local_forward_model.prediction: nearest prototype affine output, then mean-center and L2 normalize

inverse_search.initialization: prototype center whose predicted sensory composite loss is lowest; rest-effort then lower index break ties
inverse_search.step_rule: halve all steps after each complete round
inverse_search.acceptance: strict composite-loss improvement; ties retain current state

synthetic_vowel_targets.uniqueness: a motor grid point already selected for an earlier vowel is ineligible
synthetic_vowel_targets.calibration_validity: each selected point must map back to its intended nearest canonical vowel and have relative formant RMSE at most 0.25
synthetic_vowel_targets.inverse_trials: five selected vowel motor points crossed with four frozen F0 conditions, for 20 trials

equivalence_aware_verification.plant_jacobian: central finite difference of the 24-value analytic sensory vector at target motor state with coordinate delta 0.005; use one-sided difference at bounds
equivalence_aware_verification.identifiable_projector: right singular vectors above tolerance times their transpose
equivalence_aware_verification.acoustic_cycle_distance: Euclidean distance between target and final physical-plant unit sensory vectors divided by 2

gate_0_plant_validity.points: all 1024 training, 256 held-out, 1000 calibration-grid, and five selected target points

baselines.nearest_prototype: winning prototype affine intercept with no local slope
baselines.persistence: previous held-out target sensory vector in increasing Halton order; neutral tract for first point

decision_rule: Implement and execute only this exact synthetic configuration. Any failed gate is retained without changing geometry, plant equations, feature representation, babbling points, model size, ridge, baselines, loss weights, search, thresholds, targets, or gates on these points. A code defect may be corrected only if failure occurs before candidate metrics or the corrected report retains both outputs.
promotion_boundary: A full pass establishes synthetic-only evidence that a simplified geometric plant and bounded locally learned forward model can close the five-vowel analysis-by-synthesis loop. It does not promote H4, establish anatomical or infant fidelity, or authorize recorded audio.
